When questioned C L Chau stated that his instructions were to endeavour to hold a forward position but indicated to connections that due to the expected strong pace of the event it may be difficult to comply with those instructions.  He said he was also given the option of making a move during the middle stages of the race to allow the horse to hold an on-pace position, particularly as PRESTIGE GOOD races in a one-paced manner.  He said after settling behind midfield in the early stages he then after the 1400 Metres encouraged PRESTIGE GOOD to improve into the event which resulted in the horse obtaining a position outside the lead near the 900 Metres.  When questioned if there was an opportunity to attempt to hold a trailing position behind MONDIAL or THE AUSPICIOUS having regard to the early and middle sectionals of the race being run inside of standard time, C L Chau stated that, in his view, this would be contrary to the instructions he had been issued.  Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions issued and expressed satisfaction with the manner in which Jockey Chau had ridden the horse.  After considering his explanation, the Stewards advised Jockey Chau that having regard to the quick early and middle stages of the race he would have better suited by attempting to obtain a position with cover, however, they found the tactics he adopted were not unreasonable in the circumstances.

Sent for sampling post-race. <21/2/2026 STORMY GROVE (K478) - Race 11 – Sha Tin Racemeeting – 11 January 2026> The Racing Stewards have received advice from The Hong Kong Jockey Club Racing Laboratory that the post-race blood sample taken from STORMY GROVE (K478) after being placed second in Race 11 – Stanley Gap Handicap conducted at the Sha Tin racemeeting on Sunday 11 January 2026, has been found to contain lidocaine.  Analysis of the reserve portion of the sample conducted by the Laboratoire des Course Hippiques France has also confirmed the presence of lidocaine in the sample. Trainer of STORMY GROVE, Mr F C Lor has been advised of the analytical findings.  The matter has now adjourned to a date to be fixed to allow for further investigations into the matter to be conducted. <10/3/2026 STORMY GROVE (K478) – Race 11 – Sha Tin Racemeeting - 11 January 2026 – Incident Report – 10 March 2026> Mr Lor pleaded guilty to a charge under Rule 140(1) in that he as the trainer of STORMY GROVE did fail to ensure that STORMY GROVE was free of any prohibited substance on 11 January 2026, the day on which STORMY GROVE ran in Race 11 – Stanley Gap Handicap 1400 Metres conducted at the Sha Tin racemeeting on that day.  Having regard to Mr Lor’s submissions on penalty and Mr Lor’s disciplinary record in respect to like offences he was fined the sum of $50,000. Rule 138(2) of The Hong Kong Jockey Club Rules of Racing provides that if a prohibited substance is detected in a horse on raceday that the horse be disqualified from any race in which it has competed in on that day, unless the Stewards are satisfied that the administration of, or exposure to, the prohibited substance occurred after the race.  Accordingly, STORMY GROVE was disqualified from its second placing in Race 11 – Stanley Gap Handicap 1400 Metres conducted at the Sha Tin racemeeting on 11 January 2026.
